translations.web: He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that this is he who is appointed by God as the Judge of the living and the dead.
translations.bsb: And He commanded us to preach to the people and to testify that He is the One appointed by God to judge the living and the dead.
translations.kjv: And he commanded us to preach unto the people, and to testify that it is he which was ordained of God to be the Judge of quick and dead.
translations.asv: And he charged us to preach unto the people, and to testify that this is he who is ordained of God to be the Judge of the living and the dead.
